title: dar-from-lcms input manifest
description: One row per sample for batch/plate runs (MANIFEST=manifest.csv). Each column maps to the environment variable of the same name; only `file`, BASE_MASS and MOD_MASS are required, the rest fall back to the global defaults. Pattern adapted from SmartPeak's sequence.csv and nf-core's assets/schema_input.json.

file.description: mzML/.d/.raw filename (relative to OUTDIR) or an absolute path

MIRROR_MASS.description: path to a control deconvolved *_mass.txt to mirror below

EPS280.description: molar extinction coeff at 280 nm, M^-1 cm^-1

MW_DA.description: molecular weight for the mg/mL step
